import json,sys,random,time,urllib.request
upstream,coll,keyspace=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2],int(sys.argv[3])
rng=random.Random(time.time_ns())
items=[]
for i in range(1000):
    ext=f'fd-{rng.randrange(keyspace)}'
    items.append({'external_id':ext,'field':'bio','value':f'engineer {ext}'})
    items.append({'external_id':ext,'field':'email','value':f'{ext}@example.com'})
body=json.dumps({'items':items}).encode()
req=urllib.request.Request(f'http://{upstream}/collections/{coll}/index',data=body,method='POST',headers={'content-type':'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30) as r:
    sys.exit(0 if r.status<400 else 2)
